references.text: Describes the ancient custom in Israel regarding redemption and exchange, where a man took off his sandal and gave it to the other as confirmation of the agreement.
The book of Ruth tells the story of Boaz redeeming Ruth, and witnesses at the city gate confirmed the action, which connects to the sandal custom mentioned in Deuteronomy.
Isaiah was told to take off his sandals as a sign, showing the symbolic meaning of the sandal in Israel.
